gloss: that with which one is covered, covering
definition: [ מְסֻכָֿה ] noun feminine that with which one is covered, covering ; — suffix מְסֻכָֿתָ֑ךָ Ezek 28:13 (so Baer Ginsb ; van d. H. ׳ מְסֻכּ ) all precious stones were thy covering (= thou wast covered with them); — the tradition is strong in favour of Raph¢ , but sense favours derivation from סכך .
